artifact_observations.reasoning: The hair lacks micro-detail. Instead of individual strands, it appears as fused, shiny ribbons or clumps, characteristic of lower-quality AI generation or heavy compression artifacts on synthetic textures. The specular highlights are too broad and uniform.
The teeth appear fused and malformed. The boundary between the upper and lower lips/teeth is blurry and indistinct, lacking clear anatomical separation. The gum line is not clearly defined.
There is a noticeable drop in sharpness and detail around the jaw and neck compared to the eyes, suggesting a focus error or generative smoothing artifact.
